The recruitment includes 45 vacancies under the main vacancy table and two separately listed PwBD vacancies.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026 Notification
content_sections.text: Unlike recruitment drives that conduct a separate written examination, NHPC will shortlist candidates using normalized marks obtained out of 100 in the relevant GATE 2026 paper. Shortlisted applicants will participate in a Group Discussion and Personal Interview for final selection. The appointment includes one year of training in E2 Grade, followed by absorption as an Engineer or Officer and a one-year probation period upon successful completion of training. NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC has notified 47 vacancies, including 39 non-backlog vacancies and six backlog vacancies under Table 1-B, along with two separately listed PwBD vacancies under Table 1-C. Information Technology accounts for the highest number of vacancies, followed by Electronics and Communication and Environment. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities is horizontal. Candidates seeking reservation against specifically identified PwBD vacancies must have at least 40% of the relevant benchmark disability and satisfy the other prescribed conditions.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for NHPC recruitment through GATE 2026 depends on the discipline selected by the candidate. Applicants must possess the prescribed full-time regular educational qualification with the required marks and a valid GATE 2026 score in the corresponding examination paper. Only Indian nationals are eligible. Candidates appearing in the final year of their qualifying examination cannot apply for this recruitment. NHPC will consider only the educational disciplines specifically listed in the notification. Qualifications in other or equivalent disciplines are not accepted. Candidates applying for Trainee Engineer (E&C) must possess a qualification in one of the following approved disciplines: Electronics and Communication Electronics Electronics and Telecommunication Electronics and Power Power Electronics Electronics and Instrumentation Instrumentation and Control Applicants possessing AMIE are eligible under this discipline only if their enrolment was completed on or before 31 May 2013 and they satisfy the prescribed marks requirement. In addition to the essential qualification of B.E./B.Tech. in Environmental Engineering or M.Sc. in Environmental Science, NHPC has specified MSW or MBA in Rural Management as a desirable qualification for Trainee Engineer/Officer (Environment). The desirable qualification does not replace the prescribed essential educational qualification.

Full-time regular B.E./B.Tech. in Environmental Engineering or M.Sc. in Environmental Science
Full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology or B.Sc. (Engineering) in Computer Science, Information Technology or Computer Engineering, or MCA
Full-time regular M.Sc. in Geology or M.Tech. in Applied Geology, with Geology and Mathematics or Physics studied at graduation level
Full-time regular M.Tech. or M.Sc. (Tech) in Applied Geophysics, Exploration Geophysics or Geophysics

content_sections.heading: NHPC GATE 2026 Paper Codes and Score Requirements
content_sections.text: A valid GATE 2026 score in the relevant examination paper is mandatory for all five disciplines. NHPC will use normalized GATE marks out of 100 for shortlisting and final merit calculation. GATE scores from any other year are not accepted. Applicants must enter their valid GATE 2026 registration number while completing the NHPC online application. Applications submitted with an invalid registration number will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for all Trainee Engineer and Officer posts is 30 years as of 26 December 2026. Age relaxation is available to eligible reserved category candidates in accordance with the conditions specified in the official notification. The Jammu and Kashmir domicile relaxation applies to candidates who were ordinarily domiciled in the state between 1 January 1980 and 31 December 1989.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC Trainee Engineers and Officers will be placed in the E2 Grade pay scale of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 with a 3% increment structure under the Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) pattern. The approximate annual emoluments for newly appointed employees will be Rs. 16 to 17 lakh. The compensation package includes basic pay and applicable benefits under NHPC company rules: Dearness Allowance (DA) House Rent Allowance (HRA) Cafeteria Allowance Performance Related Pay (PRP) Medical facilities Provident Fund (PF) Pension and gratuity After successfully completing one year of training, candidates will be absorbed as Engineers or Officers in the same pay scale and will undergo a one-year probation period.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates belonging to the General, EWS and OBC Non-Creamy Layer categories must pay Rs. 708, including applicable taxes. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the registration fee. Additional bank charges, processing charges and applicable GST on such charges, if any, will be borne by the applicant. The registration fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Selection Process Through GATE 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC will prepare the final selection merit list using GATE 2026 marks, Group Discussion and Personal Interview performance. GATE marks carry the highest weightage of 75%, while Group Discussion and Personal Interview together account for the remaining 25%. GATE-based shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted according to normalized marks obtained in the corresponding GATE 2026 paper. Shortlisting ratio: Normally, candidates numbering up to five times the vacancies will be shortlisted. The ratio may be exceeded when candidates in the same discipline and category obtain equal marks at the shortlisting threshold. Consent form: Shortlisted applicants must submit their consent to participate in Group Discussion and Personal Interview within the notified schedule. Group Discussion and Personal Interview: Candidates must participate in both selection stages and satisfy the applicable combined qualifying marks. Psychometric assessment: Shortlisted candidates may undergo an online or offline psychometric assessment, the results of which will be used as an input during the interview. Final merit: Selection will be based on composite merit, reservation requirements, eligibility verification and availability of vacancies. Medical fitness: Selected candidates must satisfy the prescribed medical fitness standards of NHPC. Failure to submit the consent form or attend the Group Discussion and Personal Interview will result in cancellation of candidature. NHPC has not prescribed a separate qualifying cutoff for Group Discussion. Candidates must secure the applicable combined qualifying marks in Group Discussion and Personal Interview to be considered for empanelment. If candidates obtain identical final marks, preference in the merit list will be given to the older candidate. Meeting the minimum qualifying marks alone does not guarantee selection.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Service Bond
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must execute a service agreement and surety bond requiring them to complete a minimum of four years of service with NHPC, including the one-year training period.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Job Location
content_sections.text: NHPC may post selected candidates at its projects, power stations, offices, joint ventures or subsidiary companies located across India or abroad. Applicants should be prepared to work at locations assigned according to the company's requirements. Engineering and postgraduate candidates interested in similar employment opportunities can also explore the latest government job notifications .

content_sections.heading: NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The NHPC online application window will remain open from 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM to 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applicants must complete online registration and the applicable fee payment within the prescribed period. The dates, times and venues for Group Discussion and Personal Interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through their registered email addresses.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The official NHPC recruitment notification dated 25 November 2026 contains detailed information on the 47 Trainee Engineer and Officer vacancies, educational qualifications, reservation provisions, accepted GATE paper codes, selection criteria and application procedure.

content_sections.heading: NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: NHPC will open the online registration facility for Trainee Engineer and Officer recruitment through GATE 2026 on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Eligible candidates can submit their applications until 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Only candidates with a valid GATE 2026 score and registration number in the prescribed examination paper can register for the relevant discipline. Manual or paper applications will not be accepted. Applicants are not required to send printed registration forms or supporting documents through the post. Candidates must ensure that all scanned certificates are readable. Incomplete applications and applications containing invalid GATE registration numbers will be rejected. Only GATE 2026 marks in the specified examination paper will be accepted. Applicants must complete the prescribed educational qualification by the application closing date. Final-year appearing students are not eligible. Candidates should keep their registered email address active for at least one year. The category selected during online registration cannot be changed subsequently. Eligible OBC NCL candidates must possess the prescribed certificate issued within six months from the closing date of the online application. Candidates employed in Government Departments, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies must produce the required No Objection Certificate by the Group Discussion and Personal Interview stage if it is unavailable at the time of application. Applicants should regularly check the official website for recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026?
faq.answer: NHPC has announced 47 Trainee Engineer and Officer vacancies across Electronics and Communication, Environment, Information Technology, Geology and Geophysics disciplines. The total includes seven backlog vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NHPC Trainee Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 26 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Online registration begins on 27 November 2026 at 10:00 AM through nhpcindia.com.

faq.question: Q3. Is GATE 2026 mandatory for NHPC Trainee Engineer and Officer posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must possess a valid GATE 2026 score in the examination paper corresponding to their selected discipline. GATE scores from other years are not accepted.

faq.question: Q4. Can MCA graduates apply for NHPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with a recognized full-time regular MCA qualification and a valid GATE 2026 score in Computer Science and Information Technology (CS) can apply for Trainee Engineer/Officer (IT), subject to the prescribed marks and other eligibility requirements.

faq.question: Q5. Can M.Sc. Environmental Science graduates apply for NHPC recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates possessing a full-time regular M.Sc. in Environmental Science can apply for Trainee Engineer/Officer (Environment), provided they have the required educational marks and a valid GATE 2026 score in the ES paper.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Engineer (E&C), Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Engineer/ Officer (Environment), Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Engineer/ Officer (IT), Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Officer (Geology), Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA) for Trainee Officer (Geophysicist).

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for NHPC Recruitment Through GATE 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as of 26 December 2026. Eligible reserved category candidates can claim age relaxation as specified in the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals can apply. Valid GATE-2026 scorecard in the corresponding paper is required. Selected candidates should be medically fit as per extant NHPC guidelines. SC/ST and PwBD candidates with 50% marks in qualifying examination are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Final year appearing students. Candidates without a valid GATE-2026 score (GATE score of any other year is not valid). Candidates from disciplines other than those listed for each post.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on normalized GATE-2026 marks (out of 100) in the corresponding paper. Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Possible online/offline Psychometric Assessment. Empanelment on weighted score: GATE-2026 75%, Group Discussion 05%, Personal Interview 20%.
